F.interpretation_limit: A set is minimal relative to the universe of components of the condition (the nine components of the earlier stages, plus the M2 tap where the condition has one); a component outside the universe cannot be found necessary. A formal model: these numbers describe how this engine's specified operation (a recursive cycle of two configurations, status ACTIVE) responds to the manipulation. They are not evidence about any physical, biological or ecological system, and a visual representation of a run is never evidence of the run.
